name: llm-retire-scan
description: Finds OpenAI and Claude model IDs that are shut down or shutting down (GPT Image 1.5 on 2026-12-01, gpt-5 / o3 on 2026-12-11, gpt-4o / gpt-4.1 on 2027-01-14) and the request settings that break on their GPT-6 replacements; --fix rewrites the safe cases. Also finds calls to Google's Perspective API (answers until 2026-12-31).
author: Sunnatulla E
